authority: California Department of Food and Agriculture

departmentCrossChecks.result: The Department records the latest Section 4500 action as effective July 1, 2024 and links the designated California Code of Regulations service for current law.
The Department PDF endpoint returned HTTP 200 to a HEAD request and identifies the 2024 correction, but its bytes were not retained because the current-code artifact supersedes it for this review.

contradictions.subject: registry-source-age
contradictions.priorState: The registry pointed to a July 1, 2024 Department rule PDF and remained blocked pending exact retained bytes and row-level review.
contradictions.currentEvidence: California's designated current-code page states that it is current through July 17, 2026, Register 2026 No. 29, and contains 176 Section 4500 taxon rows.
contradictions.resolution: The current-code page supersedes the older candidate as the operative artifact. The 2024 Department action remains preserved as regulatory history.

contradictions.subject: designated-code-publisher
contradictions.priorState: The source authority is the California Department of Food and Agriculture while the current regulation is published through the designated Westlaw California Code of Regulations service.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The Department links the California Code of Regulations service under Current Laws and Regulations, and the retained page identifies 3 CCR Section 4500 with an explicit currentness marker.
contradictions.resolution: Authority remains the Department. The capture method, currentness marker, URL, hash, byte count, and parser denominator are explicit.

contradictions.subject: qualified-and-composite-rows
contradictions.priorState: Section 4500 includes genus, synonym, hybrid, variety, aggregate, and condition-bearing taxon rows.
contradictions.currentEvidence: Ninety of 176 rows do not pass the exact current catalog binomial gate.
contradictions.resolution: All ninety remain blocked for explicit taxonomy or scope review. No list silence or rejected row creates not-applicability or a county determination.
